name: drift-retrieval-final
creation_methodology: Prospective human-authored synthetic retrieval projects created and frozen before Phase III-B retrieval experiments.
access_policy: Do not run, inspect per-query results, change expected IDs, or tune against this dataset until retrieval and combined candidate decisions are frozen.
limitations: One engineering author; no independent relevance adjudication.
Held out from Phase III-B optimization only.
Synthetic projects do not establish real production retrieval distribution.
